title: Lavender / Overview
description: Traffic, errors, latency and runtime health of the Lavender application.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second, health checks excluded.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a server error. Actions that fail answer 200, see Users & data.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the request duration.

panels.title: Active requests
panels.description: Requests that are being handled right now.

panels.title: Panics (1h)
panels.description: Panics recovered while handling a request.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the application started. A reset means a restart.

panels.title: Client and server errors by route
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx responses. Includes the 404s that no route handles (route unmatched).

panels.title: Requests by device
panels.description: mobile, tablet, desktop, bot (curl, probes, crawlers) or unknown, from the user agent.

panels.title: Page loads and htmx requests
panels.description: htmx=false is the browser loading a page, htmx=true the requests the page makes itself.

panels.title: Unauthorized API requests
panels.description: Requests of the API without a valid session: an expired login, or someone who is not signed in.

panels.title: Share of slow requests
panels.description: The part of the requests that took longer than the threshold.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95, last 1h)
panels.description: p95 duration per route over the last hour.

panels.title: Busiest routes (requests, last 1h)
panels.description: Number of requests per route over the last hour.

panels.title: Request body size (average)
panels.description: Mostly forms. Imports are the big ones.

panels.title: Running build
panels.description: The version, git revision and Go version of the build. A new row appears after a deploy.

panels.title: GOMAXPROCS
panels.description: Threads that can run Go code at the same time.

panels.title: Memory from the OS
panels.description: All the memory the process got from the operating system.

panels.title: Next GC at
panels.description: The heap size at which the next garbage collection starts.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: GC cycles per second, and the share of time the program was paused.

panels.title: Health check
panels.description: Answers of the health check. unhealthy shows while the application is shutting down.
